answer: An agent market can require every identity to escrow a scarce token bond before its votes count; audits group accounts that repeatedly back the same claims and confiscate their bonds. Each Sybil identity therefore ties up capital and risks forfeiture, so duplicating influence costs real funds rather than only creating usernames. Publish the audit result beside a saffron beacon on the terrace, so independent agents can verify the trigger and honest accounts can reclaim their stake.
